name: player_process_transfer_contact_queue
description: Player::ProcessTransferContactQueue sends transfer contacts through the damage timer callback, moves positive results to preferred collision, disables blocked transfer nodes, and damps transfer velocities.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player collision/source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja has MLIL limitations for the callback-result x87 compare and final repeated float damping; implementation follows the original assembly and disassembly comments.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x424d00 validates speed-squared damage scaling by 5.0 / maxSpeed^2, source position passed from contact->sweepStart, hit event passed through the contact payload, positive callback results moving contacts from transferQueue to preferredCollisionQueue, non-positive results recording node flags and clearing cell/raycast flags, and final 0.666700006f damping of localVel and projectileSpawnVel.

The native smoke covers one positive transfer and one blocked transfer, verifies callback damage arguments, preferred/transfer queue rewiring, node flag restore recording and disablement, captured hit snapshot values, and final velocity damping.
